steps.content: You follow Lady Pearl through a maze of corridors. Along the way, familiar-looking stage sets flash past before your eyes.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If everything had gone according to plan, this show would have its premiere next year, making it the largest ever produced by Fortuna.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's a pity that time was not on my side. And the script is only half-finished.

"Tents fallen, homes forgotten, we've all lost our way back."

"Our quest leads to a far-off castle, just down that slender path."

"In that haven, struggles vanish, swept up in the communal dance."

"A magnificent dance, erasing every hardship!"

"Join the dance, let joy mend every wound."

"Time marches on, but the dance goes ever on, grand and timeless."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I saw these lyrics on the back of Echo's scratch paper. You wrote them?
Lady Pearl answers you with an affirmative smile. The two of you hurry along the long corridor and soon reach the door at the end.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This is Fortuna, where we get to live out the versions of our lives that we most desire, in a joyful atmosphere of music and dance...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But that would be dull if that was all there was to it, don't you think?
Lady Pearl stops at the door and turns around to look at you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: A story without ups and downs is a boring one. An inspiring story should feature this or that character hitting rock bottom and struggling to climb out.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This is a song about Fortuna. This is a story about Fortuna.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: "Along the path to the castle, four souls tread, with lightness in their steps."

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: "One walks with their head held high, only to fall from a great height. Another dances with delight, only to have their feet entangled in their fine attire."

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: "Yet another stoops to pick up a coin, only to be knocked over by a passing parade that never ends. The last sheds their earthly gains, just to keep pace with the dance."

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: "The dance shall go on, the dance shall never end."
She winks at you, then pushes open the door in front of her.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Come on, don't be afraid.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Immerse yourself in the show and discover the truth about this place.
<size=45>— Act One: Past —</size>

The man is the unknown impresario of an obscure troupe. He has great talent and capable employees, but has failed to achieve financial success. The profits generated by the performances are not enough to sustain the troupe's operations.

Fortunately, something good does come out of his talent—financial support from an investor. The investor attends the theater once a month to watch a show, and leaves a sum of money after the curtain call. This is how the troupe stays afloat.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: One day, the troupe, which has been slowly getting itself back on track, finds itself in crisis again...
It's the second day of the monthly series of performances. The impresario is sitting in his grandiose office, surrounded by a myriad of luxuries; he looks all hot and bothered.
He rummages through the contents of the safe in frustration, the sound of rummaging punctuated only by the occasional curse.
There is a heavy knock on the door. Having stopped what he's doing, the man straightens up, smooths down his clothes, and speaks:

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Come on in.
The door opens. Three other members of the troupe file in: the enthusiastic, streetwise ticket seller; the skilled prop master; and the actress with an angelic singing voice.
The impresario looks at these three key members in turn before speaking in a grave tone:

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Thank you for coming in. There's a matter that I wish to handle as discreetly as possible.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Somebody snuck into my office today. The safe was forced open, and the money we received from the investor is gone.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Hey!
The room falls silent. Glances of suspicion are exchanged.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: You're the only people who were in the theater this morning. I hate to say this, but I think the thief is among you.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: The money is very important. Without it, we won't be able to get through this month. And we'll be forced to pack our bags.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: I must find it, even if it means canceling tonight's show.
Another silence falls. The tension in the room is almost palpable. No one makes a move to break the silence for a long while...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hold on. I have a question for you.
You and Lady Pearl are in the office too, seated and watching as the farce unfolds before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You invested in the theater before you bought it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought you bought it directly.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Don't jump to conclusions, dear.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This is an unfinished script, to be completed by the choices of the performers themselves.
You catch a glimpse of Lady Pearl's airy smile beneath the brim of her hat.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's the unpredictability that makes a show more entertaining.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Let's switch to a more engaging topic... Who do you think is guilty?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll need to hear their alibis first.
- The first suspect's statement -

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: I was on the stage checking and fixing the props for tonight's performance.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: The stage lights were on. You could see my shadow, even if you couldn't see my person. The performers who took part in the rehearsal can vouch for that.
The prop master talks about his work in a matter-of-fact tone. He stands lopsided, hands jammed into his pockets, looking not in the least bothered by the unsolved mystery.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: I never went backstage this afternoon. I couldn't have stolen the money.
- The second suspect's statement -

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: I was in my dressing room the whole morning, doing vocal warm-ups. Anyone in the backstage area could hear my singing. They can vouch for that.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Besides, I'm not an extra; I receive a cut from the profits my performances produce. I would never compromise my integrity for a measly sum of money.
The actress speaks with an unmistakable air of arrogance. It seems that the question occupying her mind isn't who stole the money, but whether the pendant around her neck is eye-catching enough.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Wrap this up quickly. I've got makeup to apply and jewelry to pack.
- The third suspect's statement -

steps.speaker: Male Ticket Seller
steps.content: Me? You know I'd never do such a thing, boss.

steps.speaker: Male Ticket Seller
steps.content: They looked down their noses at me because I'm a Syndican. But not you. You took a chance on me. I'd never betray you!
The ticket seller protests his innocence, hitting his chest with an open palm to emphasize his fervent words.

steps.speaker: Male Ticket Seller
steps.content: This afternoon... Well, I admit I did slack off a little in the box office. But the box office isn't inside the theater. How was I gonna steal something when I wasn't there to steal it?

The three suspects have made their statements. They are now wearing vastly different facial expressions: the actress with an impatient frown, the prop master with glazed eyes, and the ticket seller with an awkward smile and wandering eyes.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Ah, I don't understand what all this fuss is about. Isn't it obvious that the person who is the most desperate for money is guilty?

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Pretending to be a loyal worker, and then stealing from their employer... You can never trust a dirty rat from the West District.

steps.speaker: Male Ticket Seller
steps.content: You...
The ticket seller gives the actress a hostile glare and decides to give as good as he gets.

steps.speaker: Male Ticket Seller
steps.content: Heh, get off your high horse already! You have so many fine furs and blinking jewels in your dressing room. And who helps pay off debts you owe to the luxury stores? It's none other than the investor!

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: What?! Wait... Who gave you permission to look at my bills?!
The actress slaps the ticket seller across the face. A scuffle ensues. The prop master tries to stop them, only to get dragged into the fight. It's a scene of total chaos.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Haha, playing the good guy, are we? You're in debt too!

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: "I slacked off a bit and didn't conduct a thorough check. I never thought the wire-suspended actress would fall..."

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: The girl is still lying in the hospital bed, isn't she? Heh, I seriously doubt that you have the means to pay for damages.
The verbal war rages on. Dark secrets are revealed; no one is going to emerge unscathed. Despite the chaos, you keenly sense that something else is amiss.

This is a theater, but no one present seems to care about the thing that defines a theater—performances. All they care about is money, self-interest, and that behind-the-scenes <color=#fb9259>investor</color>, each eager to clear their own name.

Lady Pearl watches the farce unfolding with interest. Like a master puppeteer, she manipulates the actors on stage to move around, to bicker, to fight, all for the purpose of putting on a good show for the audience.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: A big spender, a person from a poor background, and a debtor who has made a costly mistake...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Tell me, who is guilty?

options: That's not the end of the story.

choices.text: That's not the end of the story.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not the end of the story. We haven't heard the statement of the last suspect yet.
As if a pause button has been pressed, the actors freeze on the spot. You turn your gaze from the arguing trio to the man sitting in the center of the room: the impresario.
- The last suspect's statement -

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: I didn't steal the money.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: There wasn't any to begin with. Hadn't been any for a long time.
As if under a spell, the impresario starts speaking, his voice emotionless and flat.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: I didn't know where to borrow money, so I turned to gambling. The winnings were enough to keep the troupe afloat for another two weeks. And then slowly but surely, gambling became a habit. Whenever I started losing, I'd tell myself that I could win it all back in the next game...

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: But yesterday, I lost all the money.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: That was a deficit of millions. No way I could make it up. No way I could get out of this bind...

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Unless...

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Unless I convince everyone the money was "stolen."

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: That way, the investor won't delve too deep into the matter. As long as she doesn't know the truth, she will probably continue to finance us. It will be business as usual...

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: All the problems will be solved.
Somehow, this has become the troupe's way of life.

A way of life that involves extravagance, decadence, gambling debts... No one cares about the performing arts anymore. They squander money and time, reassuring themselves that all their problems will go away in the end.
Everyone in the troupe counts on her, pins all their hopes on her. As long as they have her to fall back on, they think, the bubble will never burst.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna was in a real pickle when I took over. It took me quite an effort to turn this losing deal into a profitable one.
Without you realizing it, Lady Pearl has come up behind you. She lays her fingers gently on your cheek. Her face is obscured by her wide-brimmed hat.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The Fortuna troupe, a once-beautiful, once-happy dream... So, who is guilty of tainting that dream?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Do you have the answer yet, my clever friend?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone in the troupe is guilty.
